summary: End-to-end verification of TripInspection.jsx enhancements (selectable scope + client-side PDF export). All 6 review-request items PASSED against the live preview with real Gemini (gemini:gemini-3.1-pro-preview). 3 Gemini analyses ran successfully (exterior-only, interior-only, both) and 2 PDF exports were captured as real browser downloads.

feature_verification.initial_state: PASS — Exterior toggle aria-pressed=true, Interior aria-pressed=false. Only exterior trip-before-input is present in DOM (interior dropzones not rendered). trip-analyze is disabled.
feature_verification.scope_inline_hint_exterior_partial: PASS — adding only EXTERIOR_BEFORE shows the inline amber hint 'Add both a Before and After exterior photo to include this area.' and trip-analyze stays DISABLED (no click-time error). Adding EXTERIOR_AFTER clears the hint and ENABLES Analyze.
feature_verification.exterior_only_analyze: PASS — Analyze returned trip-result with banner 'New damage detected this trip', single trip-section-exterior (no trip-section-interior), GLASS + LIGHT NEW findings with bbox markers.
feature_verification.pdf_export_after_exterior_only: PASS — clicking trip-export-pdf triggered a real browser download. Filename captured via page.expect_download: trip-inspection-report-1782754651316.pdf. No console errors. No JS exception.
feature_verification.interior_only_scope: PASS — after reset, toggling Exterior OFF + Interior ON removed exterior dropzones (trip-before-input count=0) and rendered interior dropzones (trip-interior-before-input count=1). Analyze succeeded with ONLY trip-section-interior (no trip-section-exterior). Findings include SEAT (torn driver seat) + STAIN (coffee spill).
feature_verification.both_areas_analyze_and_pdf: PASS — all four photos uploaded; trip-result contains BOTH trip-section-exterior AND trip-section-interior. trip-export-pdf triggered a second download: trip-inspection-report-1782754693207.pdf.
feature_verification.no_selection_guard: PASS — toggling both areas OFF shows 'Select at least one area to inspect.' and trip-analyze is disabled.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: when toggleScope turns an area OFF, that area's images are cleared but the OTHER area's previously-uploaded blobs remain. canAnalyze still gates correctly via anyComplete + intIncomplete/extIncomplete, so this is correct UX (you can selectively recompute one area). No action required.
Minor: exportPdf() swallows the failure cause inside catch (sets a generic error). Consider logging err to console for easier debugging in production. Non-blocking.
Minor: composeAnnotated() draws box numbers in fill color of NEW=red / PRE_EXISTING=amber. Confirmed working — bbox markers render on annotated exterior + interior after-images in both UI and PDF.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TripInspection v3 (selectable scope + client-side jsPDF export, no html2canvas) verified end-to-end. Use page.expect_download(timeout=30000) around the trip-export-pdf click to capture the PDF; jsPDF doc.save() triggers a real browser download with filename starting 'trip-inspection-report-'. Hidden file inputs: always use page.set_input_files (no wait_for visibility). After trip-reset, reuse DISTINCT physical file paths (/tmp/ext_before_1.png vs /tmp/ext_before_2.png) so React onChange re-fires. Real Gemini analysis took ~30-60s per call in this run; allow 180s for single-area, 220s for both areas.
